correctness.rationale: For the weighted star, the leaf vectors z_i=e_i-1/(m+1)1 give L^dagger=sum_i w_i^-1 z_i z_i^T, hence Tr[(L^dagger)^2]=((m-1)/(m+1))sum w_i^-2+(sum w_i^-1)^2/(m+1)^2 exactly. The positive budget simplex has a unique interior minimizer by coercivity and strict convexity. KKT yields a ratio of a positive mixture of t^-2 and t^-3: p_i>p_j implies (p_j/p_i)^1/2 < w_i/w_j < (p_j/p_i)^1/3. One premium spoke reduces KKT to Q[(m-1)(m+2)t^3+t^2]=(m-1)t+m^2, which has one positive root; the m^(3/2) and m^6 scalings follow by balancing asymptotic monomials and root uniqueness. Checked all limits algebraically and independently computed 42 Laplacian eigentraces and 42 KKT root cases. The second-order position-noise coherence normalization 1/(2 beta^2(m+1)) follows mode-by-mode from the two-dimensional Lyapunov equation, agreeing with Patterson-Bamieh (2013) Eq.(6).
